row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (DNS Security Essentials and up)
row.evidence: Umbrella's docs give a SCIM provisioning URL (https://api.umbrella.com/identity/v2/scim) and token for the Entra ID and Okta Cisco User Management Connector apps (create, update, deactivate users, push groups); Umbrella packages are sold only through Contact Sales.
row.notes: Quote-only: Umbrella packages (DNS Security Essentials/Advantage, SIG Essentials/Advantage) have no public prices, and Cisco says Umbrella is in a planned end-of-sale/end-of-life transition to Cisco Secure Access. SCIM (Okta and Entra ID via the 'Cisco User Management Connector' / 'Cisco User Management for Secure Access' apps, token from Admin > API Keys) provisions user and group identities used for policy, reporting and per-user licensing; it does not create dashboard administrators. Dashboard admin SSO is SAML only for authentication (roles are set in Umbrella, the admin email must already exist); admins are managed in the dashboard or via the Users and Roles API (create, list, get, delete). Entra provisioning requires an Entra ID premium licence.

plans.name: DNS Security Essentials
plans.notes: No prices published; packages are sold through sales and Umbrella is in end-of-sale transition to Cisco Secure Access. Which packages include identity provisioning is not stated on the pages loaded.

auth.token_source: Admin > API Keys > Static Keys > Azure Active Directory Provisioning (or Okta provisioning) > Generate Token
auth.notes: Cisco recommends refreshing the token at least every 90 days; the token is shown once.

operations.notes: Entra's tutorial lists 'Remove users' and group memberships; Umbrella's Okta page says deactivation deactivates the user.

filtering.notes: Docs say the connector app must support filtering on the chosen matching attribute; the supported filter attributes are not listed.

attributes.notes: Mapping from the Entra ID section; Okta objectGUID can also be imported as a custom Okta attribute.

roles.how: Provisioned users are policy identities; dashboard roles are not set via SCIM

limitations.text: Groups limit: 1000 groups per Umbrella's docs (Entra and Okta); Microsoft's tutorial says 200.
Changes after the initial sync can take up to an hour to show in the dashboard.
Entra ID provisioning needs a premium Microsoft Entra ID licence; concurrent sync from the on-prem AD Connector is not supported.
Provisioned identities are for policy and reporting, not dashboard administrator accounts.

capabilities.notes: Users here are Umbrella dashboard user accounts; the role is set at creation.

endpoints.purpose: List the user accounts in the organization
Create a user account with a designated role
List the roles in the organization

okta.notes: Listed as 'Cisco User Management Connector'; OIN markup checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking.

entra.notes: Provisioning app 'Cisco User Management for Secure Access'; dashboard SSO via the separate 'Cisco Umbrella Admin SSO' gallery app.

fallbacks.other_sync: On-premises Cisco AD Connector sync of users and groups; manual identity import

open_questions: Which Umbrella packages include Okta/Entra identity provisioning is not published.
SCIM endpoints, version and pagination are not documented beyond the provisioning URL.
Whether deprovisioned identities free a per-user licence is not documented.
Users and Roles API rate limits and an admin audit-log API were not confirmed.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud provisioning not documented.
